meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 处理长任务时把计划和进度记进文件,中断后还能接着干。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要跑几十步、中途可能中断的开发或调研任务。
copy.tagline_en: Keep an AI task's plan and progress in files so long jobs resume where they stopped.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your dev or research task spans many steps and tool calls.

howto.what: Claude 把计划、发现、进度写进项目里的 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md，当作磁盘工作记忆。每完成一个阶段就更新状态、记录错误，/clear 后仍能恢复。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆分或组织多步骤项目、研究任务，或工作预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发；/clear 后也可自动恢复上次会话。

say.note: 先建立 task_plan.md 再动手

say.text: 继续上次的计划，先读 task_plan.md 和 progress.md
say.note: 读取已有计划文件接着做

say.text: 把这阶段的结论和错误更新到 progress.md

howto.what_en: Claude writes its plan, findings, and progress into three markdown files — task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md — as working memory on disk. It updates phase status and logs errors, so work survives /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project or research task, or work needing 5+ tool calls. It can also recover a previous session after /clear.

say_en.text: Plan this multi-step task and write the plan into task_plan.md
Resume the previous plan — read task_plan.md and progress.md first
Update progress.md with this phase and log any errors
